content.text: The Mistake Almost Every Creator Makes First

Most [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-nobody-2|How Creators]] make the mistake of building their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-working|digital]] commerce stack on top of a third-party payment platform like Stripe or PayPal, thinking it's the easiest way to get paid internationally. But what they don't realize is that these platforms hold the keys to their business, and can freeze or shut down their accounts at any moment, leaving them with no way to get paid. It's a fragile setup that's just one wrong move away from disaster.
Why This Keeps Happening Even to Experienced Sellers

This keeps happening because even experienced sellers think they're doing the right thing by following the rules, but the truth is, the rules are rigged against them. Every platform has its own set of rules and requirements, and if you don't meet them, you're out of luck. And even if you do meet them, there's always the risk of something going wrong, and your account getting shut down. It's a cat-and-mouse game that creators and sellers can't win.
The Real Cost of Getting This Wrong

The real cost of getting this wrong is not just financial, but also reputational. When your account gets shut down, your customers are left wondering what happened, and your business takes a hit. And even if you manage to get your account back up, the damage is already done. Your customers have lost trust in you, and you've lost credibility in the market. It's a one-way ticket to failure.
Using a decentralized payment method like NOWPayments is the key to avoiding platform risks and maintaining control over your payments.
How to Build the Stack That Cannot Be Taken Down

To build the stack that cannot be taken down, you need to use a decentralized payment method like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]], which allows you to accept payments directly from your customers, without relying on a third-party platform. This way, you're in control of your payments, and can't be taken down by a platform owner. It's a setup that's robust, reliable, and scalable.
The Infrastructure Decision That Changes Everything

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
